row.answer: Kai'Sa is a marksman/mage whose attacks and Void Seeker build Plasma toward a missing-health magic damage burst. Her kit deals physical and magic damage, with AD, AP and attack speed enabling ability evolutions. She can dash near Plasma-marked champions with a shield.
